mapper.sql: B.BBS_ID AS BOARD_ID, B.PST_SN AS POST_ID, B.PST_TTL AS TITLE, B.PST_CN AS CONTENT, B.WRTR_NM AS WRITER_NAME, CASE WHEN B.BBS_ID = 'LRNSUP' THEN B.ETC1 ELSE B.CTGR_CD END AS CATEGORY_CODE, CASE WHEN B.BBS_ID = 'LRNSUP' THEN CASE B.ETC1 WHEN 'PRE' THEN '사전학습' WHEN 'MAIN' THEN '본학습' WHEN 'POST' THEN '사후학습' ELSE B.ETC1 END ELSE C.CD_DTL_NM END AS CATEGORY_NAME, B.NTC_YN AS NOTICE_YN, B.UPEND_FIX_YN AS PINNED_YN, CASE WHEN M.NEW_YN = 'Y' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, B.REG_DT, NOW()) <= COALESCE(M.NEW_NMTM, 0) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS NEW_YN, B.LNKG_URL_ADDR AS LINK_URL, B.PSTG_YMD AS PUBLISHED_DATE, B.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO AS ATTACHMENT_FILE_ID, B.THMB_FILE_ID AS THUMBNAIL_FILE_ID, ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = B.THMB_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS THUMBNAIL_URL, B.VOD_FILE_ID AS VIDEO_FILE_ID, CASE WHEN B.BBS_ID = 'LRNSUP' AND B.ETC2 = 'VIDEO' THEN B.ETC5 ELSE ( SELECT F.ATCH_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ATCH_FILE_INFO F WHERE F.ATCH_FILE_MNG_NO = B.VOD_FILE_ID ORDER BY F.FILE_SEQ ASC LIMIT 1 ) END AS VIDEO_URL, COALESCE(B.INQ_CNT, 0) AS VIEW_COUNT, B.REG_DT AS REGISTERED_AT, B.MDFCN_DT AS MODIFIED_AT
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM BBS_ARTICLE B LEFT JOIN BBS_MST M ON M.BBS_ID = B.BBS_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN CMMN_CD_DTL C ON C.CD_ID = M.CTGR_CD_ID AND C.CD_DTL_ID = B.CTGR_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN B.UPEND_FIX_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, B.PSTG_YMD DESC, B.REG_DT DESC, B.PST_SN DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BBS_ARTICLE B LEFT JOIN BBS_MST M ON M.BBS_ID = B.BBS_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT B.CTGR_CD AS CATEGORY_CODE, COALESCE(MAX(C.CD_DTL_NM), B.CTGR_CD) AS CATEGORY_NAME FROM BBS_ARTICLE B LEFT JOIN BBS_MST M ON M.BBS_ID = B.BBS_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN CMMN_CD_DTL C ON C.CD_ID = M.CTGR_CD_ID AND C.CD_DTL_ID = B.CTGR_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.BBS_ID = #{boardId} AND M.BBS_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.CTGR_CD IS NOT NULL AND B.CTGR_CD != '' AND (B.PSTG_YMD IS NULL OR B.PSTG_YMD = '' OR B.PSTG_YMD <= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')) GROUP BY B.CTGR_CD ORDER BY CATEGORY_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE

SELECT FROM BBS_ARTICLE B LEFT JOIN BBS_MST M ON M.BBS_ID = B.BBS_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN CMMN_CD_DTL C ON C.CD_ID = M.CTGR_CD_ID AND C.CD_DTL_ID = B.CTGR_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.BBS_ID = #{boardId} AND B.PST_SN = #{postId} AND (B.BBS_ID = 'LRNSUP' OR M.BBS_ID IS NOT NULL) AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (B.PSTG_YMD IS NULL OR B.PSTG_YMD = '' OR B.PSTG_YMD <= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'))

SELECT N.PREVIOUS_POST_ID, N.PREVIOUS_POST_TITLE, N.NEXT_POST_ID, N.NEXT_POST_TITLE FROM ( SELECT B.PST_SN, LEAD(B.PST_SN) OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN B.UPEND_FIX_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, B.PSTG_YMD DESC, B.REG_DT DESC, B.PST_SN DESC ) AS PREVIOUS_POST_ID, LEAD(B.PST_TTL) OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN B.UPEND_FIX_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, B.PSTG_YMD DESC, B.REG_DT DESC, B.PST_SN DESC ) AS PREVIOUS_POST_TITLE, LAG(B.PST_SN) OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN B.UPEND_FIX_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, B.PSTG_YMD DESC, B.REG_DT DESC, B.PST_SN DESC ) AS NEXT_POST_ID, LAG(B.PST_TTL) OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN B.UPEND_FIX_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, B.PSTG_YMD DESC, B.REG_DT DESC, B.PST_SN DESC ) AS NEXT_POST_TITLE FROM BBS_ARTICLE B LEFT JOIN BBS_MST M ON M.BBS_ID = B.BBS_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE B.BBS_ID = #{boardId} AND (B.BBS_ID = 'LRNSUP' OR M.BBS_ID IS NOT NULL) AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (B.PSTG_YMD IS NULL OR B.PSTG_YMD = '' OR B.PSTG_YMD <= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d')) AND ( #{boardId} != 'LRNSUP' OR B.ETC3 = ( SELECT CURRENT_POST.ETC3 FROM BBS_ARTICLE CURRENT_POST WHERE CURRENT_POST.BBS_ID = #{boardId} AND CURRENT_POST.PST_SN = #{postId} ) ) ) N WHERE N.PST_SN = #{postId}
